areas.name: Sydney Enclosed Waters
areas.synoptic: Northwesterly winds freshen today ahead of a southerly buster this afternoon, with squally gusts and possible thunderstorms. Strong and gusty southerly winds continue through Saturday night and Sunday. Winds are forecast to ease early next week as a high pressure ridge moves across before the next change moves through mid next week.

warnings.title: Hazardous Surf Warning for New South Wales
warnings.detail:
Surf and swell conditions are expected to be hazardous for coastal activities such as rock fishing, boating, and swimming in the following areas.
Hazardous Surf Warning: Hunter Coast and Sydney Coast
Hazardous Surf Warning: Byron Coast, Coffs Coast, Macquarie Coast, Hunter Coast, Sydney Coast, Illawarra Coast, Batemans Coast and Eden Coast
NSW Police Force, Marine Area Command advise that: People should consider staying out of the water and avoid walking near surf-exposed areas. Rock fishers should avoid coastal rock platforms exposed to the ocean and seek a safe location that is sheltered from the surf. Boaters planning to cross shallow water and ocean bars should consider changing or delaying their voyage. Boaters already on the water should carry the appropriate safety equipment and wear a lifejacket. Boaters should remember to log on with their local Marine Rescue radio base, via VHF Radio or the Marine Rescue APP, and consider their safety management plan.
